name: Hua Nan Financial Holdings Co., Ltd.
description: Hua Nan Financial Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through Bank, Securities, Insurance, and Other segments. The company provides various banking services, including commercial banking, offshore banking, overseas branch banking, and other banking services. It also engages in the trust business planning, managing, and operating; custody of nondiscretionary trust funds and mutual funds; trading and underwriting of securities; margin loan and securities financing for securities; securities-related auxiliary futures trading; buying and selling of foreign securities; and other securities-related businesses. In addition, it acts as a transfer agent for securities; offers property insurance services, including automobile insurance, fire insurance, casualty insurance, and reinsurance of the insurance businesses; and issues beneficiary certificates to raise investment trust funds and making securities investments using these funds. Further, the company is involved in the venture capital investments and investment and management consulting businesses; purchase, leasing, evaluation, and auction of properties; management service of monetary creditor's rights of financial institutions; financing and leasing; futures broker and consulting business; and security investment consulting business. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
